declaration.evidence_note: Support intervals are measured only at each candidate peak. They do not prove a whole band is continuous or identify a wall. Filtered or empty results do not prove an object is absent.
declaration.display_note: For a returned-image point (rx, ry), first multiply by original_pixels_per_returned_pixel to obtain full combined-image coordinates (fx, fy). On the left, original image coordinates are (box_left + fx, box_top + fy). On the right, subtract mask_panel_combined_pixels[0] from fx before adding box_left. Prefer candidates and support intervals, which already use original-image coordinates.

limits: All saved drafts/readings retained with original values and hashes; later successful revisions do not erase failures.
Historical runs have no separate before/after normalization ledger; absence is not proof of no manual normalization.
No ground-truth data or convention adjustment is written back to these readings.
